title: AMZCHEF Espresso Machine 20 Bar, Compact Coffee Maker with LED Touch Screen & Steam Milk Frother, Espresso Maker with 41oz Removable Water Tank for Home & Office, Coffee Machine for Cappuccino, Latte
features: Touch control espresso machine: LED touch screen for single/double shots or custom extraction (hold icon 5s). Stainless steel, compact. 41oz removable tank, easy refill & clean. Ideal for home baristas.

20 Bar Italian Professional Pump – AMZCHEF espresso machine features a 20-bar high-pressure pump made in Italy. It deeply extracts ground coffee to deliver a perfect layer of rich crema every time. Maximizes flavor for a consistently bold and intense espresso.

1350W Fast Preheating System – Amzchef espresso machine heats up in just 30–40 seconds and maintains steady temperature for consistent brewing. Delivers rich aroma and top-quality extraction. Perfect for cappuccino, latte, or flat white at home or office.

Professional Steam Wand – The adjustable milk frothing wand creates rich, velvety microfoam that elevates your coffee and lets you pour latte art like a pro. The 8mm one-piece design is easy to clean and delivers dry, steamy performance.

User-friendly – Everything a coffee enthusiast needs to get started: espresso machine, 1.2L removable water tank, single/double filter, portafilter, tamper with spoon, and manuals. Perfect for both home brewers and professional baristas.
